parsed.note_claim: Sony dropped the Physint game first before any Xbox selection by Kojima.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: "in mid-June of this year, we unexpectedly received notice from PlayStation Studios that they would cancel the Physint project," says Kojima in a tweet. "Physint is an important project both to me personally and to Kojima Productions. Determined to keep the project alive, we have spent the last three months searching tirelessly for a new partner."
parsed.reason: The page directly confirms that PlayStation cancelled the project first, after which Kojima searched for and selected Xbox as a new partner, substantiating the note's claim.
